system.description:
Each point spent on the religious lore skill gives a +1 bonus to intelligence checks made to recall knowledge about religions, their targets of worship, and the creatures associated with them.

The effective intelligence score used for the religious lore check should be modified by the obscurity of the knowledge being sought. Identifying a statue of a well-known god should be much easier than identifying the purpose of a particular religious rite from a foreign religion.

Note: Characters should be assumed to know all about the rites and details of their own religion without needing to make religious lore checks.
